record.dic_text:
05661 `Abdiy'el {ab-dee-ale'}

源自 05650 和 0410; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Abdiel 1; 1

押比疊 = "神的僕人"
1) 迦得人古尼的兒子, 亞希的父親, 於猶大王約坦時期居住在巴珊地 (#代上5:15|)
record.edic_text:
05661 `Abdiy'el {ab-dee-ale'}

from 05650 and 0410;; n pr m

AV - Abdiel 1; 1

Abdiel = "servant of God"
1) a Gadite, son of Guni and father of Ahi and one who settled in the
   land of Bashan in the time of king Jotham of Judah
